justification: Inspected the production package files under javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/resolution/typesolvers/: AarTypeSolver.java (83 LOC), MemoryTypeSolver.java (98), ReflectionTypeSolver.java (113), ClassLoaderTypeSolver.java (155), CombinedTypeSolver.java (316), TypeSolverBuilder.java (325), JavaParserTypeSolver.java (356), and JarTypeSolver.java (382), for 1,828 LOC total. The package is cohesive and narrowly centered on type solving from specific sources (reflection/classloader, source trees, jars, AARs, in-memory declarations, and solver composition/building), so I did not find evidence of an excessively large or responsibility-overloaded God Component.
